design_status: post-audit long-only mandate-transfer rerun; pooled 34-date panel
analysis_representation: within-universe centered active books; shared-access operating control

operating_performance.entry_rule: first available close strictly after the signal date
operating_performance.exit_rule: last available close on or before the next calendar month-end
operating_performance.assignment_rule: one model-to-information-seat assignment is fixed across all dates
operating_performance.comparison_control: shared access over identical holding windows
operating_performance.equal_weight_reference: constant 1/14 target weights over the same holding windows
operating_performance.turnover_definition: half the absolute trade from return-drifted end weights to next-month target weights

allocation_decomposition.identity: Var(equal-weight team return) = sum_i Var(r_i)/K^2 + 2 sum_{i<j} Cov(r_i,r_j)/K^2
